Class LogoSimulation

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mdi3D.view3D.logoDemo.LogoSimulation
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.cnu.mdi.sim.Simulation
public class LogoSimulation extends Object implements edu.cnu.mdi.sim.Simulation
Simulation wrapper for the rotating MDI-logo demo.

This class contains no UI code. It is executed on the simulation thread by the MDI simulation engine, exactly like AizawaSimulation and KineticsSimulation.

Unlike those two demos, this simulation has no numerical model to integrate — each step only advances a rotation angle by a fixed increment. Because that has essentially zero computational cost, step sleeps briefly before doing its (trivial) work, so the simulation thread self-paces instead of busy-spinning and consuming a full CPU core for no visual benefit. SimulationEngine applies no throttling of its own between step() calls, so a step body that is this cheap must pace itself.

    • takePendingDelta

      public float takePendingDelta()
      Take the animation-angle increment accumulated since the last call and reset the accumulator to zero.

      Intended to be called only from an EDT-marshaled onSimulationRefresh hook; the increment side runs on the simulation thread in step. Both sides share lock so a refresh can never observe a torn (partially-added) accumulation.

      Returns:
      the accumulated animation-angle increment, in degrees, since the previous call
